items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I don't know if you ever did get to meet him, Cy Gerard.

ctx.x: What, as close as you can figure out, what was the style of that Wolverines group? Was it, did they connect it all with any more?
The Wolverines, as I once spoke to a fellow around here that used to play saxophone. I don't know if you ever did get to meet him, Cy Gerard.
Never did. You told me about him, I never met him.
